_comment: Pre-written advisory responses. Used (1) verbatim when no LLM is available, and (2) as the answer set for the on-device LLM, which only ROUTES a farmer's question to one of these intents — it never writes advice itself (a 0.5B model invented unsafe advice in testing, e.g. approving DDT). Swahili text needs review by a native speaker / extension officer before field deployment. Every response ends with a recommendation, never a command or an automatic action.

en.summary: This looks like coffee leaf rust. It makes orange or yellow powder under the leaves and spreads fast in warm, wet weather.
en.doNow: We suggest you cut off the worst branches today and burn them. Do not put them in compost.
en.treatment: A copper fungicide, like copper oxychloride, works well. Spray within 3 days, then every 2 weeks while the rains last.
en.prevention: Prune so air can move between trees, keep weeds down, and feed the trees well. Strong trees fight rust better.
en.spread: The orange powder blows in the wind and sticks to hands and clothes. Check the trees next to this one, and wash your hands after touching sick leaves.
en.safety: When you spray, cover your skin, eyes and mouth, and keep children and animals away. Read the label for how much to use.
en.getHelp: If more than a few trees have rust, it is a good idea to tell your extension officer or co-op, so neighbours can check too.

sw.summary: Hii inaonekana kuwa kutu ya majani ya kahawa. Inaleta unga wa rangi ya machungwa au njano chini ya majani, na huenea haraka wakati wa joto na mvua.
sw.doNow: Tunashauri ukate matawi yaliyoathirika zaidi leo na uyachome. Usiyaweke kwenye mbolea.
sw.treatment: Dawa ya kuvu yenye shaba, kama copper oxychloride, inafaa. Nyunyizia ndani ya siku 3, kisha kila wiki 2 wakati wa mvua.
sw.prevention: Pogoa ili hewa ipite kati ya miti, ondoa magugu, na lisha miti vizuri. Miti yenye nguvu hupambana na kutu vizuri zaidi.
sw.spread: Unga wa machungwa hupeperushwa na upepo na hushika mikono na nguo. Kagua miti iliyo karibu, na osha mikono baada ya kugusa majani yaliyougua.
sw.safety: Unaponyunyizia, funika ngozi, macho na mdomo, na weka watoto na wanyama mbali. Soma maelekezo kwenye lebo kuhusu kiasi cha kutumia.
sw.getHelp: Kama miti mingi ina kutu, ni vizuri kumjulisha afisa ugani au chama cha ushirika, ili majirani nao wakague.

en.summary: This looks like coffee leaf miner. Small caterpillars eat tunnels inside the leaf, leaving pale, dry patches.
en.doNow: We suggest you pick off the damaged leaves and destroy them, then check the trees around this one.
en.treatment: A neem-based spray is a good first choice. A pyrethroid spray also works. Spray in the early morning.
en.prevention: Keep some shade over the coffee and do not spray insect killers too often, because they also kill the wasps that eat the miner.
en.spread: The adult is a tiny moth that flies to nearby trees. Dry seasons make outbreaks worse.
en.safety: When you spray, cover your skin, eyes and mouth, and keep children and animals away. Read the label for how much to use.
en.getHelp: If many leaves are falling off, it is a good idea to ask your extension officer which spray is allowed in your area.

sw.summary: Hii inaonekana kuwa mchimbaji wa majani ya kahawa. Viwavi wadogo hula njia ndani ya jani, na kuacha madoa meupe yaliyokauka.
sw.doNow: Tunashauri uchume majani yaliyoharibika na uyaangamize, kisha ukague miti iliyo karibu.
sw.treatment: Dawa ya mwarobaini ni chaguo zuri la kwanza. Dawa ya pyrethroid pia inafaa. Nyunyizia asubuhi na mapema.
sw.prevention: Acha kivuli juu ya kahawa na usinyunyizie dawa za wadudu mara nyingi, kwa sababu zinaua pia nyigu wanaokula wadudu hawa.
sw.spread: Mdudu mzima ni nondo mdogo anayeruka kwenda miti ya jirani. Kiangazi hufanya mlipuko kuwa mbaya zaidi.
sw.safety: Unaponyunyizia, funika ngozi, macho na mdomo, na weka watoto na wanyama mbali. Soma maelekezo kwenye lebo kuhusu kiasi cha kutumia.
sw.getHelp: Kama majani mengi yanaanguka, ni vizuri kumuuliza afisa ugani dawa ipi inaruhusiwa eneo lako.

en.summary: This looks like phoma leaf spot. It makes dark brown spots on leaves, often after cold, rainy weather on high ground.
en.doNow: We suggest you remove the spotted leaves and prune thick branches so air and light can get in.
en.treatment: A copper fungicide or a systemic fungicide can help. Avoid watering from above the leaves.
en.prevention: Windbreaks protect trees from cold wind damage, which lets phoma in. Keep the canopy open.
en.spread: It spreads by rain splash from leaf to leaf, so it moves most in wet, windy weeks.
en.safety: When you spray, cover your skin, eyes and mouth, and keep children and animals away. Read the label for how much to use.
en.getHelp: If young shoots are dying back, it is a good idea to show your extension officer.

sw.summary: Hii inaonekana kuwa ugonjwa wa madoa ya phoma. Unaleta madoa ya kahawia iliyokolea kwenye majani, mara nyingi baada ya baridi na mvua maeneo ya juu.
sw.doNow: Tunashauri uondoe majani yenye madoa na upogoe matawi mazito ili hewa na mwanga viingie.
sw.treatment: Dawa ya kuvu yenye shaba au dawa ya kimfumo inaweza kusaidia. Epuka kumwagilia juu ya majani.
sw.prevention: Vizuizi vya upepo hulinda miti dhidi ya upepo baridi unaoruhusu phoma kuingia. Weka matawi wazi.
sw.spread: Huenea kwa matone ya mvua kutoka jani hadi jani, kwa hiyo huenea zaidi wiki za mvua na upepo.
sw.safety: Unaponyunyizia, funika ngozi, macho na mdomo, na weka watoto na wanyama mbali. Soma maelekezo kwenye lebo kuhusu kiasi cha kutumia.
sw.getHelp: Kama machipukizi machanga yanakauka, ni vizuri kumwonyesha afisa ugani.

en.summary: This looks like brown eye spot. It makes round brown spots with a light centre, like an eye. It is often a sign the tree is hungry.
en.doNow: We suggest you check how the tree is fed first. This problem is often linked to too little nitrogen or potassium.
en.treatment: A balanced fertiliser usually helps most. Use a copper spray only if the spots are spreading fast.
en.prevention: Feed trees regularly, mulch the soil, and give young plants some shade.
en.spread: It spreads slowly by wind and rain, mostly on weak or young trees.
en.safety: When you spray, cover your skin, eyes and mouth, and keep children and animals away. Read the label for how much to use.
en.getHelp: A soil test from your co-op or extension officer can show which nutrient is missing.

sw.summary: Hii inaonekana kuwa ugonjwa wa doa la jicho la kahawia. Unaleta madoa ya mviringo ya kahawia yenye katikati nyeupe, kama jicho. Mara nyingi ni ishara kwamba mti una njaa.
sw.doNow: Tunashauri kwanza uangalie jinsi mti unavyolishwa. Tatizo hili mara nyingi linahusiana na upungufu wa naitrojeni au potasiamu.
sw.treatment: Mbolea iliyosawazishwa kwa kawaida husaidia zaidi. Tumia dawa ya shaba tu kama madoa yanaenea haraka.
sw.prevention: Lisha miti mara kwa mara, weka matandazo kwenye udongo, na wape miche michanga kivuli.
sw.spread: Huenea polepole kwa upepo na mvua, hasa kwenye miti dhaifu au michanga.
sw.safety: Unaponyunyizia, funika ngozi, macho na mdomo, na weka watoto na wanyama mbali. Soma maelekezo kwenye lebo kuhusu kiasi cha kutumia.
sw.getHelp: Kipimo cha udongo kutoka chama cha ushirika au afisa ugani kinaweza kuonyesha virutubisho vinavyokosekana.

en.summary: This leaf looks healthy. We did not see signs of disease.
en.doNow: No action is needed now. Keep checking your trees, especially after rain.
en.treatment: No treatment is needed. Keep feeding and pruning as usual.
en.prevention: Regular pruning, weeding and feeding keep trees strong.
en.spread: Nothing to spread. If nearby trees look sick, scan them too.
en.safety: No spray is needed for a healthy tree.
en.getHelp: If the tree looks weak even though the leaves look fine, your extension officer can help.

sw.summary: Jani hili linaonekana zima. Hatukuona dalili za ugonjwa.
sw.doNow: Hakuna hatua inayohitajika sasa. Endelea kukagua miti yako, hasa baada ya mvua.
sw.treatment: Hakuna dawa inayohitajika. Endelea kulisha na kupogoa kama kawaida.
sw.prevention: Kupogoa, kupalilia na kulisha mara kwa mara huweka miti imara.
sw.spread: Hakuna kinachoenea. Kama miti ya jirani inaonekana kuugua, ipige picha pia.
sw.safety: Mti ulio mzima hauhitaji kunyunyiziwa dawa.
sw.getHelp: Kama mti unaonekana dhaifu ingawa majani ni mazuri, afisa ugani anaweza kusaidia.

en.summary: We are not sure what this is. The photo was not clear enough to say.
en.doNow: Try another photo: one leaf, close up, in good daylight, showing the underside.
en.treatment: We suggest you do not spray anything until the problem is known.
en.prevention: Keep the tree's sick leaves away from other trees until you know more.
en.spread: We cannot say how this spreads until we know what it is.
en.safety: Do not use a spray without knowing the problem. It may not help and costs money.
en.getHelp: If a clear photo still says 'not sure', it is a good idea to show the leaf to your extension officer.

sw.summary: Hatuna uhakika hii ni nini. Picha haikuwa wazi vya kutosha.
sw.doNow: Jaribu picha nyingine: jani moja, karibu, kwenye mwanga mzuri wa mchana, likionyesha upande wa chini.
sw.treatment: Tunashauri usinyunyizie dawa yoyote hadi tatizo lijulikane.
sw.prevention: Weka majani yaliyougua mbali na miti mingine hadi ujue zaidi.
sw.spread: Hatuwezi kusema jinsi linavyoenea hadi tujue ni nini.
sw.safety: Usitumie dawa bila kujua tatizo. Huenda isisaidie na inagharimu pesa.
sw.getHelp: Kama picha iliyo wazi bado inasema 'sina uhakika', ni vizuri kumwonyesha afisa ugani jani hilo.

en.summary: This leaf has a problem, but it is not one of the coffee diseases agriOS knows. We cannot name it.
en.doNow: We suggest you keep this leaf, or a photo of it, to show your extension officer.
en.treatment: We suggest you do not spray anything until the problem is known. The wrong spray may not help.
en.prevention: Keep sick leaves away from other plants until you know more. Check the plants nearby.
en.spread: We cannot say how this spreads until we know what it is. Washing your hands after touching it is a good idea.
en.safety: Do not use a spray without knowing the problem. It may not help and costs money.
en.getHelp: It is a good idea to show this leaf to your extension officer or co-op. They can tell you what it is.

sw.summary: Jani hili lina tatizo, lakini si ugonjwa wa kahawa ambao agriOS inaujua. Hatuwezi kulitaja.
sw.doNow: Tunashauri uhifadhi jani hili, au picha yake, umwonyeshe afisa ugani.
sw.treatment: Tunashauri usinyunyizie dawa yoyote hadi tatizo lijulikane. Dawa isiyo sahihi huenda isisaidie.
sw.prevention: Weka majani yaliyougua mbali na mimea mingine hadi ujue zaidi. Kagua mimea iliyo karibu.
sw.spread: Hatuwezi kusema jinsi linavyoenea hadi tujue ni nini. Ni vizuri kunawa mikono baada ya kuligusa.
sw.safety: Usitumie dawa bila kujua tatizo. Huenda isisaidie na inagharimu pesa.
sw.getHelp: Ni vizuri kumwonyesha afisa ugani au chama cha ushirika jani hili. Wanaweza kukuambia ni nini.

en.summary: agriOS cannot see a leaf in the picture, so there is nothing to check yet.
en.doNow: Point the camera at one leaf. Hold it close so the leaf fills the picture.
en.treatment: No advice yet. First let agriOS see one leaf clearly.
en.prevention: For a good check, use daylight, hold the phone still, and show one leaf at a time.
en.spread: We cannot say anything yet. Show agriOS one leaf first.
en.safety: We suggest you do not spray anything based on this scan. No leaf was checked.
en.getHelp: If agriOS still finds no leaf, try again in good daylight. Your extension officer can also help.

sw.summary: agriOS haioni jani kwenye picha, kwa hiyo hakuna cha kukagua bado.
sw.doNow: Elekeza kamera kwenye jani moja. Ishike karibu ili jani lijaze picha.
sw.treatment: Hakuna ushauri bado. Kwanza acha agriOS ione jani moja vizuri.
sw.prevention: Ili kukagua vizuri, tumia mwanga wa mchana, shika simu bila kutikisa, na onyesha jani moja kwa wakati.
sw.spread: Hatuwezi kusema chochote bado. Onyesha agriOS jani moja kwanza.
sw.safety: Tunashauri usinyunyizie dawa yoyote kutokana na picha hii. Hakuna jani lililokaguliwa.
sw.getHelp: Kama agriOS bado haioni jani, jaribu tena kwenye mwanga mzuri wa mchana. Afisa ugani pia anaweza kusaidia.

en.outOfScope: I can only help with this scan result. For other questions, it is a good idea to ask your extension officer or co-op.

sw.outOfScope: Ninaweza kusaidia tu kuhusu matokeo ya picha hii. Kwa maswali mengine, ni vizuri kumuuliza afisa ugani au chama cha ushirika.
